identitySignals: Official ACF page describes the Office on Trafficking in Persons (OTIP) as part of the Administration for Children and Families, a division of the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services, matching the agenda name exactly
OTIP's contact address is in Washington, D.C., matching the agenda location 'Washington, DC'

OUSD's Human Trafficking Prevention page says OUSD received a federal grant for 2020-28 for human trafficking prevention education in middle and high schools, and links to the OTIP events calendar, matching the agenda's STEP Human Trafficking Prevention Grant under Community Schools and Student Services
research.notes: Federal agency, not a company: no EIN, CA entity number or SAM UEI recorded. No main phone number found on the OTIP pages. acf.gov serves a bot challenge to some automated fetchers, so some fields may be dropped by the checker.

profile.address: 330 C Street S.W., 7th Floor, Washington, D.C. 20201
profile.summary: The Office on Trafficking in Persons (OTIP) is part of the Administration for Children and Families, a division of the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services. It advises the Assistant Secretary for Children and Families on federal anti-trafficking activities and develops strategies, policies and programs to prevent human trafficking and support survivors.
